title: Mod_security false positives: whitelisting without floodgates
lede: WAF blocks the WordPress save button at 16:12 on a Wednesday. The fix isn't SecRuleEngine Off; it's a tight whitelist, rule by rule, route by route, that holds.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of mod_security audit log printouts, whitelist folder, WAF brass plate, ruler, pencil on bone linen.
